reason: I already pay a small amount for my terminal and I run a cash discount, so $49 plus a $299 reader is a lot to risk on something new. I would sooner ask in the Facebook group what other owners use before I switch anything.
objection: What happens when the internet goes down on a busy Saturday? They say it keeps working, but I have not seen it work, and if card payments fail with a line of clients I lose money that day.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three other Vietnamese salon owners in my Facebook group using it for a few months and saying it works offline on busy days, plus a free trial on my own iPad before I buy the $299 reader.
